en-US.description: Sorts thousands of illustrations and AI-generated images by character and scene, entirely on your PC.
en-US.longDescription:
Art Sorter is a Windows app for people whose image folders got out of hand: AI outputs, saved illustrations, screenshots, fan art.
Drop a folder on the window and it looks at the pictures, not the file names. Images of the same character are grouped, split by scene, then put in sequence. Resized copies and near-duplicates are set aside for review, and appearance tags are detected automatically.
The result is plain folders on your disk. No library, no database, nothing uploaded. Analysis, sorting and duplicate detection run on your own PC and work offline. Tags can be exported to Hydrus Network, XMP (digiKam, XnView), CSV, or sent to Eagle.
Free preview sorts the whole folder and keeps 300 images in full quality. One-time purchase, no account required. The first launch downloads the analysis models (about 840 MB) once.
en-US.name: Art Sorter
